about.label: About Me
about.heading: Building reliable digital products with clarity and purpose.
about.description: Building production-grade web applications end to end — from high-performance document processing portals returning results in under <time>15 seconds</time> to offline-first e-commerce stores, real-time dashboards, and full-stack management platforms. hero.tagline: Frontend & Mobile Product Engineer from Indonesia — building production-grade software with structural speed, readability, and design integrity.

story.label: My story
story.heading: From curiosity to craft.
story.p1: My path into software started the way most do — curiosity. What began as tinkering with web pages during Informatics Engineering turned into an obsession with how interfaces feel, not just how they work. Somewhere between my first React component and my first production deploy, I found the thing I want to be great at.
story.p2: Today I build across the stack — React, React Native, Node.js, Go — but my heart lives in the frontend: interfaces that load fast, read clearly, and feel intentional. I have shipped an offline-first POS for an agriculture platform, a real-time interview platform over WebRTC, and an AI contract analyzer that reads legal PDFs in under fifteen seconds.
story.p3: I grow by shipping. Hackathons taught me to build under pressure — and to win #JuaraVibeCoding doing it. Internships taught me that real users forgive nothing. Certifications like BNSP and Google AI keep me honest about fundamentals. Everything else I learn in public: open source, side projects, and this site.

values.label: How I work
values.heading: Principles I build by.
values.v1d: Code is read far more often than it is written. I optimize for the next developer — clear structure, honest naming, no clever traps.
values.v2d: Speed shapes how software feels. Offline-first thinking, sub-15-second pipelines, and bundle budgets are requirements, not extras.
values.v3d: Every pixel earns its place. Typography, spacing, motion — design integrity separates a product from a demo.
values.v4d: Open source, case studies, certifications — growth compounds when it is shared. This portfolio is part of that habit.
